title: Nominative Case
description: The nominative case as subject and predicate
descriptionRussian: Именительный падеж как подлежащее и сказуемое
intro: Russian has six grammatical cases that change word endings based on function. The nominative case (именительный падеж) is the 'dictionary form' - how words appear when you look them up. It's used for the subject of a sentence (who/what does the action) and after 'это' (this is).
rules: Nominative is the 'dictionary form' - how words appear in dictionaries and word lists.
Use nominative for the subject of a sentence: Кошка спит. (The cat is sleeping.)
Use nominative after «это»: Это книга. (This is a book.)
Question words Кто? (Who?) and Что? (What?) ask for nominative answers.
examples: Студент читает. (The student is reading.), студент is nominative (subject)
Это мой друг. (This is my friend.), друг is nominative (after это)
Кто это? — Это Анна. (Who is this?, This is Anna.)
Что это? — Это книга. (What is this?, This is a book.)

items.prompt: In «Мама читает книгу», which word is the subject (nominative)?
items.promptEnglish: In 'Mom is reading a book', which word is the subject?
items.explanation: Мама (mom) is doing the reading, so it's the subject in nominative case.

items.prompt: In «Собака спит», which word is in nominative case?
items.promptEnglish: In 'The dog is sleeping', which word is in nominative?
items.explanation: Собака (dog) is the subject doing the sleeping - nominative case.

items.prompt: Which question asks for a nominative answer about a person?
items.explanation: Кто? (Who?) asks about people and expects a nominative answer.
After это, use nominative: книга (not книгу or книге).
Учитель is the subject (who is working), so it's in nominative.

items.prompt: Which question asks for nominative about a thing?
items.explanation: Что? (What?) asks about things and expects a nominative answer.

explanations: 'Это' takes nominative — the basic dictionary form. студент is correct here.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student is reading the newspaper.
minimalPairs.explanation: The student is the subject (doing the reading), so use nominative: Студент.
After это, use nominative: моя книга.
